cases.name: Kendra Carnes
cases.about: Tammy Bailey described her daughter as a “happy, loving person.” Carnes was one of five children. She had struggled with drugs and had gone to rehab this year, her mother said. “She used to love to play basketball,” Bailey recalled tearfully. Growing up, “she was a tomboy.” She had worked at Fresh Mark Inc. for about a year, Bailey said. “She had a lot of friends,” she continued. “She loved to take selfies. She really will be truly missed.”
cases.narrative: On 8/5/2015, Her body was found just after 2 p.m. Wednesday by three teenagers who were fishing in Newman Creek in Massillon.
